title: Sneaky Snitch
use_for: Someone is up to something: scheming, sneaking, getting caught, sus behaviour, a plan forming.
description: An oboe and a snare drum dance a tantalizing number with the whimsical plucks of a string quartet. The staccato nature of the music suggests walking on tiptoes, while the nasal notes of the oboe flits about almost imperceptibly.
